title: Describe an Environmental Process

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Write your own first draft and submit it for feedback.
prompt: Write 120–160 words for a community notice about a practical action to protect a local place. Explain the problem, the steps in the process, who is involved and why the action matters. Use at least six lesson words, at least two present passive sentences and by + agent where useful.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Organize four parts: place and problem; first and later steps; participants and materials; expected benefit. Check am / is / are + past participle and name the agent only when helpful.
